_doc: Story camera (src/hell/story_camera.gd): follow, lead, fight framing, zoom breathing, ultimate punch, impact kick. Distances in world px, rates per second (exponential smoothing 1 - exp(-rate * dt)), zoom values multiply the base zoom.
_pixel_doc: Pixel skins retain the base zoom and snap the combined camera translation in physical screen pixels, including window stretch. HD keeps breathing/punch zoom. teleport_distance is the maximum per-tick world-pixel displacement to interpolate; larger jumps snap. Rendering lags simulation by up to one fixed tick; gameplay positions are never changed.
_hud_bottom_doc: hud_bottom: the share (0..0.4) of the view height the skill bar and its hints cover at the bottom of the screen (about 76 of 720 px). The view sits half of it lower (view_shift, added to the camera offset), the room clamp grows by that at both ends, and the crowd zoom fits foes into the free part only.
